messages:
maya: quick sync / follow-up to quant RFC: prototyped a tiny activation-density probe to steer fp8/int8/4bit. posting notes and rollout questions.

devon: define probe pls. cheap or heavy?

maya: cheap: single-token forward at layer1 (configurable n_tokens). density = count(|act|>tau)/n_elems. tau default 1e-3.

ron: mapping thresholds? we need explicit mapping for routing code.

maya: suggested map: d <= 0.20 -> int8-4bit lane; 0.20 < d <= 0.48 -> fp8-fast; d > 0.48 -> fp8-calib or fp16. values live in quant_profile.

devon: security: clients might pass density_hint header. runtime should validate: if |hint - probe| > 0.12 ignore hint and emit telemetry.

maya: telemetry keys: density_probe, probe_source (live|cache), hint_present, hint_used, selected_lane, degscore_delta. sample 1/10 on hot endpoints.

ron: perf impact?

devon: bench: median +0.3ms, p99 +0.9ms when probe runs. cached snapshot -> near zero.

maya: rollout plan: internal 48h -> canary 2% 72h (alert degscore > 0.01) -> 20% -> GA opt-in. add per-endpoint toggle to disable probe.

ops-bot: pilot nodes label=quant-probe=true created and canary job scheduled at 1795550300 by infra@release-bot :white_check_mark:

maya: i'll open PR with schema change + probe impl + runbook. tagging @devon for review.

ron: LGTM. short and practical.
